missingDatExperiment.scope: One successful baseline request followed by one separate exact-build missing-path request with retry count zero and a 15-second post-return observation window. The no-retry and no-fallback result applies only to the missing-path request and does not establish global behavior.
safety: A read-only filesystem precheck confirmed that the same-length alternate path data\2A\08\00\1G.DAT did not exist.
No installed file or Resource path wrapper was renamed, moved, overwritten, truncated, deleted, or modified.
The original path code unit and full temporary path buffer were restored and read back before any error-path instruction executed.
All breakpoints were removed, all threads were resumed, the debugger detached and closed normally, and the client remained responsive.
missingDatExperiment.staticReconciliation: At 0x00453CDA a nonzero errno branches through the retry-count check. Retry count zero reaches the single direct FUN_00456960 call at 0x00453D54, then the failure epilogue clears AL before returning. BCS-Y-2234 continues after 0x00C96984; BCS-Y-2235 resumes after its direct BCS-Y-2234 call at 0x00C96B6D and returns at 0x00C96B73.
missingDatExperiment.limits: The no-retry and no-fallback findings apply only to the one missing-path request and its 15-second observation window. Successful substituted-path ownership, successful redirected read completion, normal-read closure, identity forwarding at the pre-open boundary, and cross-build signature stability remain unresolved.
